# `TimeTravelLedger` drives the pure session reducer; the contract crate never depends back on this one.
semio-framework-time-travel = { workspace = true }
# 🎚️ Continuous controls (ticket 26/09/30/NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING lane W3-T2-CONTROLS): every dispatch carrying a
# `gesture` rides the window's `ScrubLedger`; the contract crate never depends back on this one.
semio-framework-tool-machine = { workspace = true }
# 🔤️ First-party RFC 4648 §5 base64url codec: the tool run trace delta rides the scene `toolRunTrace` lane as
# unpadded base64url text (ticket 26/09/13/INTERACTIVE-TOOLS-VISIBLE-PROCESS lane W0-H).
base64_codec = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-io-base64" }

# the interactive-step contract, which this crate calls directly as `semio_framework_trace::…`. The
# call site landed without the manifest edge, so every build of this crate failed on an unlinked crate.
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-hash" }
# 🗃️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (sdk-dedyn, O1): `#[dyn_enum]` on `trait PluginApp` —
# each fleet plugin crate closes its own per-plugin app enum via `dyn_enum_close!` (cross-crate,
# see 📓️terra-dyn-enum-macro-report.md's recipe §5).
semio-framework-dispatch-macros = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🔀️dispatch/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-dispatch-macros" }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
# 🧩️ UNIFIED-COMPOSABLE-ARTIFACT-SYSTEM (C1): `ArtifactChildren`'s `slots() -> &'static
# [ChildSlotSpec]` needs the real `ChildSlotSpec`/ `ArtifactCompositionFields` types A2 landed in
# this crate — not otherwise reachable from `semio-framework-plugin` (`semio-framework` itself does
# not depend on `semio-framework-schema`). No cycle: `semio-framework-schema` depends only on
# `semio-framework-os-kernel` + its own derive crate, never on this crate or `semio-framework`.
semio-framework-schema = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧬️schema/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-schema" }
# 🧬️ The semantic UI contract and its headless runtime replace `ui_wgpu`'s node types here: both are
# dependency-light (serde + styling tokens) and compile for wasm32-wasip2, where the old dependency
# dragged a whole render engine into every guest.
# 🏷️ Still needed for the NON-node types the ui crate owns — app labels, context-menu requests,
# window measures, world3d camera helpers. Those are separate domains from the node schema this
# program replaced, so they keep their home; the "wgpu" feature is declarative types only and
# stays wasm32-wasip2-safe (it never pulls the engine, which lives behind "wgpu-engine").
ui_wgpu = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui", features = ["wgpu"] }
semio_framework_ui_contract = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧬️contract/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-contract" }
semio_framework_ui_runtime = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧠️runtime/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-runtime" }
# 🧬️ M2 fallout (ticket 26/08/17 `design-unified.md`, terra-sdk-wire): the `scene-surface` packet
# relocated the 15 product scene structs (`TableScene`, `World3dScene`, …) plus their helpers
# (`world3d_default_selection_json`) out of `ui_wgpu::wgpu` into this new crate — `ui_wgpu` no
# longer re-exports them, so this SDK needs the dependency directly to keep compiling.
semio_framework_ui_scene = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🎬️scene/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-scene" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
# 🪶️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01): default features drop
# `bitflags` — `world actor`'s WIT (`🧬️schema/📜️.wit`) declares no `flags` type, so wit-bindgen's
# generated code never calls into it; confirmed dead (one leftover generic-instantiation symbol,
# no real function) in the built `.wasm` before this change. `async`/`std`/`realloc`/`macro-string`
# stay: `poll` is `async func` in the WIT and genuinely exercises `wit_bindgen::rt::async_support`
# (266 distinct linked symbols observed in a built component). See
# `🔍️research/📓️wit-bindgen-guest-surface.md`.
wit-bindgen = { version = "0.57.1", default-features = false, features = ["macros", "realloc", "async", "std", "macro-string"] }
# 🌱️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01): `ArtifactApp::Snapshot`/
# `Config`/`Draft`/`Presence`/`Transient` now bound on `ToValue`/`FromValue` instead of
# `Serialize`/`DeserializeOwned` (`../../📦️packages/🦀️rust/🦀️.rs`'s trait definitions). Promoted from
# `[dev-dependencies]` because the crate's own production defaults (`NoConfig`/`NoPresence`/
# `NoTransient`, `crate::local_interaction`'s `InteractionConfigMutation`) derive `ToValue`/
# `FromValue` directly now, not only the test fixtures.
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
# 🚪️ Test-only `entrypoint`: `one_framework_reserved_route_fits_a_bounded_thread_stack` drives one
# `interactionSelect` on a deliberately small OS thread, and only `block_on` can pump a future from
# inside a `std::thread` the test spawned itself (the `#[async_test]` executor is bound to libtest's
# own thread). Dev-only, so no interactive-reachable build ever sees the gate open.
semio-framework-async = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/⏳️async/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-async", features = ["entrypoint"] }
wasmtime = { version = "47.0.3", features = ["cranelift"] }

# 👶️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (P1-process-shards, `design-runtime.md` §2: "the
# `semio-shard` `[[bin]]` runs over stdio"). Hosts one `ShardLoop` over `process_transport::
# StdioTransport` — see `🧵️shard/👶️child/🦀️.rs`'s own module doc for the CLI contract.
[[bin]]
name = "semio-shard"
path = "../../🧵️shard/👶️child/🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-ui-locale = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🌐️locale/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework = { path = "../../../../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework" }
semio-framework-ui-contract = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧬️contract/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
ui_wgpu = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui", features = ["wgpu"] }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
semio-framework-os-config = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }
# 🎭️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (B1-host-native): `GuestRuntime`'s `RuntimeActorId`/
# `PackageId`/`PackageHash` vocabulary (design-runtime.md §2) — packet A1's pure, domain-neutral
# actor crate, already a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
semio-framework-actor = { workspace = true }
# ⚡️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (terra-effects-async): `⚡️effects/🦀️.rs`'s
# `AsyncEffectExecutor` derives `OperationContext`/`ScopeHandle`/`ChannelPolicy` (this crate's own
# vocabulary is domain-neutral, zero tokio) and dispatches onto `HttpPool`/`StorageScheduler`/
# `TimerWheel`/`ComputePool`/`EventRouter` (packet R2's tokio-backed services) — same dependency
# shape `semio-framework-os-services` itself already establishes.
# 🧵️ P1c (one-pool-worker-runtime): `"entrypoint"` is required (not merely `cfg(test)`) because
# `🧵️shard/🧵️executor/🦀️.rs`'s `ShardExecutor::run` calls `semio_framework_async::block_on` from a
# PRODUCTION `WorkerPool` job closure (a plain OS thread, no async executor already polling it) —
# the same shape `ComputePool`/`TokioHostRuntime` bridges use, per `semio-framework-async`'s own
# `block_on` gate doc.
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true, features = ["entrypoint"] }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-os-services = { workspace = true }
# 🐕️ P1c (one-pool-worker-runtime): `ShardLoop::execute_turn_for`/its job-step counterpart wrap each
# guest call in a `semio_framework_trace::Watchdog` so an over-8ms turn is recorded as a contract
# violation instead of silently absorbed — see `📓️p1c-actor-shards.md`.
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
# ⏳️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (terra-runtime-rewrite): `⏳️runtime/🦀️.rs`'s
# `AsyncActorTask` is one `tokio::spawn`ed task per actor, coordinated with its caller over
# `tokio::sync::{mpsc,oneshot}` — the ONLY tokio surface this crate needs. `["sync", "rt"]` only:
# tokio itself stays OWNED by `semio-framework-os-services` (the ticket's binding tokio-routing
# rule) — this crate must never construct a `tokio::Runtime`; `tokio::spawn`/`JoinHandle` run
# against whatever `Handle` is current when a caller enters it, injected from outside, never built
# here. `rt-multi-thread` is deliberately NOT enabled — building a scheduler is exactly what this
# crate is forbidden to do.
tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["sync", "rt"] }
# 🧬️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (B1 world-collapse): `component-model-async` is
# declared EXPLICITLY rather than left to feature unification through `wasmtime-wasi` —
# `Config::wasm_component_model_async`, `Store::run_concurrent`, `Accessor`, `StreamReader` and the
# `*_async`/concurrent call shapes of every `bindgen!` export are all `#[cfg(feature = ...)]`-gated
# on it, and the collapsed `world actor` cannot be linked or called without them.
wasmtime = { version = "47.0.3", features = ["cranelift", "component-model", "component-model-async"] }
wasmtime-wasi = "47.0.3"
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
# 🎯️ PLUGIN-DEPENDENCIES-ARTIFACT-CONTRIBUTIONS-AND-COMPOSITE-MUTATIONS (W2-A): `HostTransactionCoordinator`
# hashes a `ForeignStep`'s payload into `protocol::PayloadHash` for `MutationOrigin::Contributed`, the
# exact algorithm `📡️spr/🎮️command/🦀️.rs`'s own `Planner` cycle-guard already uses.
semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
# 🧪️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (terra-effects-async): `testkit` (unions with the

path = "../../🧪️tests/🔒️closed-ports/🦀️.rs"

manifests.name: semio-framework-ui
manifests.source:
[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-ui"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Handcrafted semio UI: declarative components plus the terminal (feature \"tui\") and wgpu (feature \"wgpu\") retained-mode targets"
build = false

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "ui"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[features]
default = []
testkit = ["wgpu-engine"]
# ⌨️ Terminal target: semio-styled scene/cell renderer, wasm-safe. Carries no platform I/O on its own.
tui = ["dep:semio-framework-async"]
# 🖥️ Native terminal backend for `tui`: raw mode, alt screen, stdin ANSI input decoding.
tui-terminal = ["tui", "dep:libc"]
# 🌐️ wasm-bindgen exports of the tui `WasmHost` for browser hosts (xterm.js); never default.
tui-bindgen = ["tui", "dep:wasm-bindgen"]
# 🧊️ wgpu target: declarative component types only, so wasm32-wasip2 program components stay light.
# Names the target, not the `wgpu` crate — that one only arrives with `wgpu-engine` below. `bytemuck`
# backs `draw_types::{UiInstance, VectorVertex}` (GPU vertex layout structs with zero `wgpu`-crate
# reference — pure `#[repr(C)]` value types); its own dependency is `bytemuck_derive`, a proc-macro
# that runs on the host at build time and links nothing into the target binary. `semio-framework-job`
# backs `prepared.rs`'s job-driven CPU staging/admission state machine (first-party, itself already
# wasip2-safe). Neither reintroduces the `wasm-bindgen` leak this ticket closes. Ticket
# 26/09/01/RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS.
wgpu = ["dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:semio-framework-ui-locale", "dep:semio-framework-value-derive", "dep:bytemuck", "dep:semio-framework-job"]
# 🎨️ Full retained-mode engine for `wgpu`: arena/tree/layout/text/input/gpu rendering.
wgpu-engine = [
    "wgpu",
    "dep:parley",
    "dep:swash",
    "dep:bytemuck",
    "dep:winit",
    "dep:wgpu",
    "dep:taffy",
    "dep:js-sys",
    "dep:wasm-bindgen",
    "dep:web-sys",
    "dep:arboard",
    "dep:semio-framework-geometry",
    "dep:semio-framework-job",
    "dep:semio-framework-async",
    "dep:semio-framework-pixels",
]
# 🧬️ Enables the owned TypeScript schema projection for the `wgpu` boundary types.
typegen = ["wgpu"]

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
ui_styling = { path = "../../🎨️styling/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-styling" }
# 🎬️ The 15 product scene structs (`World3dScene`/`TableScene`/...) and the generic 3D scene math
# both relocated out of this crate into `semio-framework-ui-scene` — ticket
# 26/08/17/MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME packet `scene-surface`. `component::ui` re-exports
# the former; `kernel_3d_scene` is now a re-export of the latter's `math` module. Non-optional: both
# are re-exported unconditionally from `component::ui`, which itself has no feature gate.
ui_scene = { path = "../../🎬️scene/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-scene" }
# ⛓️ Consumed directly for the `wgpu-engine` widgets that still take `Camera3d` by value (see
# `widgets.rs`); `semio-framework-ui-scene`'s `math` module re-exports `Mat4`/`Vec3` from here too.
semio-framework-geometry = { path = "../../../📐️geometry/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-geometry", optional = true }
semio-framework-job = { path = "../../../🧵️job/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
# 🖼️ Owned PNG codec (first-party, its only dependency is the owned DEFLATE module) backing
# `🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/🖌️paint`'s `🖼️UiImageSources` region: a `Component::Image` whose `src` is a
# `data:image/png` URL decodes in-process instead of showing the placeholder box. No third-party
# image crate enters the graph — see that region's own docstring for the JPEG carve-out.
semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-async = { path = "../../../⏳️async/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-ui-locale = { path = "../../🌐️locale/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive", optional = true }
ui_contract = { path = "../../🧬️contract/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-contract" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
serde_json = { version = "1.0.140", optional = true }
# 🖋️ Text shaping/font-fallback (parley) + rasterization (swash) for the `text` region's glyph
# atlas — versions match what `layout_rs` already resolves in the workspace lockfile (parley
# pulls fontique 0.5.0 transitively; accessed here via `parley::fontique`, not a direct dep).
# `no_std` + `libm` like `ui-render`: embedded font bytes only, no fontique path/mmap sources.
parley = { version = "0.5.0", default-features = false, features = ["libm"], optional = true }
swash = { version = "0.2.6", default-features = false, features = ["render", "std"], optional = true }
bytemuck = { version = "1.24.0", features = ["derive"], optional = true }
# ⚠️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01): restored after an
# attempt to move this behind a `not(target_env = "p2")` target table — reverted because
# `♾️infinite`'s `🌍️world/🦀️.rs` unconditionally names wgpu-engine symbols that need this
# tier to exist even for `wasm32-wasip2`. See `🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/🦀️.rs`'s top docstring.
wgpu = { version = "29.0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "wgsl"], optional = true }
# 📐️ The retained target's production layout solver (`🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📐️flex`). `grid` joins
# `flexbox` because `LayoutSpec::Grid` is a first-class contract variant React renders as real CSS
# grid — same feature set `semio-framework-ui-render` already resolves for the same reason.
taffy = { version = "0.9", default-features = false, features = ["std", "flexbox", "grid", "taffy_tree"], optional = true }

[target.'cfg(not(target_os = "wasi"))'.dependencies]
winit = { version = "0.30.12", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_06"], optional = true }

# 🐧️ winit's Linux backends are features; these load their system libraries at run time (no dev packages).
[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
winit = { version = "0.30.12", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_06", "x11", "wayland", "wayland-dlopen"], optional = true }

[target.'cfg(all(unix, not(target_arch = "wasm32")))'.dependencies]
libc = { version = "0.2.186", optional = true }

# 🌉️ Browser-only device/session bindings (`🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu`'s canvas/clipboard/fetch/cursor
# bridges — cursor.rs, prepared.rs, host.rs, text.rs, gpu.rs — plus `tui-bindgen`'s xterm.js
# export). Excluded from `wasm32-wasip2` because `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the WASI
# component target too. wasip2 plugin components have no direct DOM/canvas/clipboard access from
# the guest (that is host-mediated through the UI contract), so these become undefined for that
# target rather than getting a wasip2 arm — nothing in the shipped plugin path calls them.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
wgpu = { version = "29.0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "webgpu", "wgsl"], optional = true }
js-sys = { version = "0.3.83", optional = true }
wasm-bindgen = { version = "0.2.106", optional = true }
web-sys = { version = "0.3.98", optional = true, features = [
    "Window",
    "Navigator",
    "Clipboard",
    "HtmlCanvasElement",
    "OffscreenCanvas",
    "HtmlElement",
    "CssStyleDeclaration",
    "MouseEvent",
    "WheelEvent",
    "KeyboardEvent",
    "Request",
    "RequestInit",
    "RequestMode",
    "Response",
] }

[target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'.dependencies]
wgpu = { version = "29.0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "metal", "vulkan", "dx12", "wgsl"], optional = true }
# 📋️ OS clipboard read/write for `host::clipboard_write_text`/`clipboard_read_text` — pure-Rust X11/
# Wayland (Linux), NSPasteboard (macOS), Win32 (Windows) backends, no system dev headers required.
arboard = { version = "3", optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async = { path = "../../../⏳️async/📦️packages/🦀️rust", features = ["entrypoint"] }
semio-framework-ui-viewport = { path = "../../🪟️viewport/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
tiny-skia = "0.11.4"
# 🧪️ Keeps `#[test] async fn` bodies' literal `async` while expanding to a sync harness — see the
# crate's own doc comment. Dev-only: `--lib` never links it, only `--tests`/`--all-targets` do.
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

manifests.name: pdf-1-7-e-lopdf-engine
manifests.source:
# 🧭️ Own workspace root: never joins the repository's root workspace, whose root manifest is a shared,
# contended file.
#
# 🚫️ DEPENDS ON `lopdf` AND NOTHING ELSE — deliberately, and this is the entire point of the crate.
# The generator it replaces obtained both the mutated bytes AND the expected projection from this
# repository's own `semio-s-artifact-stdio-pdf-test-oracle`, which made `lopdf` a codec for our own answer:
# both halves of every comparison descended from one implementation, so a shared misreading of the PDF
# specification would produce two agreeing wrong answers. Here the mutation is applied through `lopdf`'s
# own public COS API and the projection is read back through it, so nothing in this repository predicts
# what the judge is judging.
#
# @see ../../../../../../../../../.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️27/SUBSET-SCOPED-EXTERNAL-ORACLE-MUTATION-TESTING/📓️pdf-fixtures-are-not-admissible-evidence.md
[workspace]

[package]
name = "pdf-1-7-e-lopdf-engine"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "generate"
path = "../../🏗️generate/🦀️.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "reader"
path = "../../📖️reader/🦀️.rs"

[lib]
name = "pdf_e_lopdf"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
lopdf = "0.44"

manifests.name: semio-framework-replication
manifests.source:
[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-replication"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Product-neutral replication contract: lane-tagged client/server frames, causal mutation envelopes, the mutation trait family, conflict vocabulary, the .spr record format and the pack codec primitives beneath them. Spoken identically by the optimistic local replica and the authoritative server; depends on neither."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "replication"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "protocol"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[features]
default = []
# 🗜️ Deflate segment compression (`CodecId(1)`); off by default so the pure contract stays dependency-light.
deflate = ["dep:semio-framework-deflate"]
# 🧪️ Cross-crate opt-in for `OrderedSet`'s hand-written `Serialize`/`Deserialize`
# (🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🧺️set/🦀️.rs's `ArrayWire` region). Plain `#[cfg(test)]` only covers THIS
# crate's own oracle test — a downstream crate's `#[cfg(test)]` build never activates a dependency
# crate's own `#[cfg(test)]` code, so a real cross-crate consumer (`os-flow`'s
# `Widget`/`FlowPreviewGui`, whose own `#[cfg_attr(test, derive(Serialize, Deserialize))]` needs
# this bound) must enable this feature explicitly instead.
ordered-set-serde = ["semio-framework-value/ordered-set-serde"]

[dependencies]
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-schema-registry = { path = "../../../🧬️schema/📇️registry/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-schema-state = { path = "../../../🧬️schema/📶️state/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value.workspace = true
semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-deflate = { path = "../../../🗜️deflate/📦️packages/🦀️rust", optional = true }
semio-framework-io-base64 = { path = "../../../🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }
# 🚨️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01, TENTH seam pass): STILL
# NOT movable to `[dev-dependencies]`, for three remaining reasons — see `📓️orderedmap-tenth-seam.md`.
# The ninth-seam pass's blocker (1) (the `to_dsl_value`/`from_dsl_value` and `encode_wire_serialized`/
# `decode_wire_serialized` bridges) stays resolved, unchanged from before. Blocker (2)'s FOURTH
# item — `🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🦀️.rs`'s `OrderedMap<V>: Serialize` (the real `os-kernel` neural-engine
# `Dictionary` caller) — is now ALSO resolved this pass: `Dictionary`, `Value`, `Atom`, `Neuron`,
# `Tree`, `FieldSpec`, `Schema`, `ChannelSpec`, `OperatorInfo`, `VariadicSpec`, `Cardinality` (all in
# `💻️os/🧠️neural/⚙️engine/🦀️.rs`) and `🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/🕸️wasm/🦀️.rs`'s `FlowExtension*` family
# moved to `ToValue`/`FromValue` + `pack::json`; `OrderedMap<V>: Serialize` is now `#[cfg(test)]`-only.
# THREE items of blocker (2) remain live and unconverted, each independently sufficient to keep
# `serde`/`serde_json` here — confirmed still present by direct read, not carried forward stale:
# - `🌱️value/🦀️.rs`'s `impl serde::Serialize/Deserialize for DslValue` (a deliberate, still-live
#   transitional bridge for OTHER serde-deriving types that hold a `DslValue` field, e.g. `ui_wgpu`'s
#   `ActionDescriptor`) and `impl From<&DslValue> for serde_json::Value` (real, actively-called
#   JSON-export/UI-boundary bridges, confirmed via `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio`/`🏭️process` and the
#   `wgpu` UI target's own callers).
# - `🌱️value/🗂️ordered/🧺️set/🦀️.rs`'s `OrderedSet: Serialize + Deserialize` (real callers in
#   `💻️os/🔨️modules/🌊️flow/**` and the `🌀️procedural` plugins).
# - `InteractionState` and its `🕹️interaction/**` siblings, hit DIRECTLY via
#   `serde_json::to_string`/`from_str`/`from_slice`/`from_value`
#   (`💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/🦀️.rs:9860,9864,9875`, `🕹️interaction/📃️query`/`📡️live`), never
#   through `encode_wire_serialized` — separate follow-up work, not covered by this pass.
# Do not attempt further per-type removal by grep-for-`serde_json`-near-the-name alone — the
# `MutationDescriptor` finding in `📓️replication-serde-removal.md` proved that method misses
# derive-based fan-out in `os-kernel`/`os` consumer structs; only a real `cargo check
# -p semio-framework-os-kernel` after the edit proves a type is safe to drop. This pass's own
# fan-out (`FieldSpec`/`Schema`/`ChannelSpec`/`OperatorInfo`, and `os-flow`'s `FlowExtension*`
# family) was found the same way — by removing the impl and reading the compiler, not by grepping.
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

# 🌉️ `⚠️diagnostic`'s `fault_to_js`/`result_fault_to_js` hand a `Fault` across the JS boundary as a
# `JsValue`; `🧩️puzzle`'s `🌉️wasm` bridge calls them on ~20 lines, so the dep is retired together
# with those two functions and their callers, not ahead of them. Gated `not(target_env = "p2")`
# because `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the WASI component target too — the same exclusion
# `💻️os`'s own browser-bridge block uses, and the reason those two functions carry the same cfg.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.106"

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
blake3 = "1.8.2"
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[package]

[features]
default = ["session-bindgen"]
# 🌉️ wasm-bindgen session wrappers (Map/Terrain/…) — disabled when this file is path-mounted into
# infinite (avoids duplicate TerrainSession symbols linking surface+infinite into one cdylib).
session-bindgen = []

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.dev]
wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

# 🪶️ REDUCE-DEMONSTRATOR-IDLE-MEMORY-FOOTPRINT. Applies when 📜️script.ts builds with wasm-pack
# `--profile wasm-release` (wasm-pack 0.15+ maps any custom profile name to this `custom` section,
# ignoring `profile.release` above). Runs after wasm-bindgen, mirroring os-dev's plugin -Oz post-pass
# (WASM_OPT_ARGS) minus `--low-memory-unused`: this module's stack-first memory layout means the
# "low 1KB is unused" assumption binaryen makes for that flag is unverified here.
[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.custom]
wasm-opt = ["-Oz", "--strip-debug", "--strip-producers", "--enable-bulk-memory", "--enable-bulk-memory-opt", "--enable-call-indirect-overlong", "--enable-extended-const", "--enable-multivalue", "--enable-mutable-globals", "--enable-nontrapping-float-to-int", "--enable-reference-types", "--enable-sign-ext"]

path = "🦀️.rs"

serde_json = "1.0.140"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png"] }
# 🏔️ Required by the path-mounted `🏔️terrain/🦀️.rs` above, which decodes Terrarium RGB-encoded
# elevation PNGs via the first-party codec (no third-party runtime dependency) instead of `image`.
# RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01).
semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pixels" }

# 1 024-record array never lands in the constructing frame. Unconditional: `semio-framework-job`
# above already pulls this crate in on every target.
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
# 🌱️ `protocol::value::{DslValue, ToValue, FromValue, ValueError}` — the SAME nominal type
# `semio-framework-os-kernel` re-exports (`os_dsl::schema` re-exports `protocol::value::*`

# dependency edge back to this crate (`cargo tree -p semio-framework-replication` — hash,
# io-base64, value-derive, serde, serde_json only), so this does not create the os-kernel cycle.
semio-framework-replication = { workspace = true }
# 🧬️ Proc-macro for `#[derive(ToValue, FromValue)]` — leaf crate (syn/quote/proc-macro2 only), no
# edge back to this crate (`cargo tree -p semio-framework-value-derive -i`).

# wgpu-web hosts). Excluded from `wasm32-wasip2` because `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the
# WASI component target too — declaring these under the bare arch gate linked `wasm-bindgen` (and,
# via the `wasm_bindgen_futures` alias, this crate's own first-party async runtime) into the shipped
# plugin component. The wasip2 guest path is `semio-framework-plugin`'s `component-guest` feature,
# not this bridge.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]

wasm-bindgen = "0.2.106"

[dev-dependencies]

# `pack_encode`/`pack_decode` (see the module doc's "opaque seam" note) — serde only proves the
# `ToValue`/`FromValue` derive against serde's own independent shape inside `#[cfg(test)]`, so it
# never reaches a non-test build.
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
# 🧪️ terra-shard-grants: proves the Part A serde-shape fix by actually serializing to bytes and
# back (`serde_json`, not an in-process equality check — that is exactly what hid the `JobStep`
# newtype-variant defect this fix generalizes). Dev-only: the crate core has zero `serde_json`
# dependency on its real wire, which stays `pack_encode`/`pack_decode` (see the module doc's
# "opaque seam" note) — this never reaches a non-test build.
serde_json = { workspace = true }
# 🧪️ terra-actor-green: `#[async_test]` keeps this crate's test fns' literal `async fn` (universal-
# async convention) while expanding to a plain `#[test]` harness over an inline, dependency-free
# `block_on` — see R4 clause 5 (a `#[test]` fn body is a sanctioned executor entry point).
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

# 🧭️ Own workspace root: this crate joins NEITHER the repository's shared root Cargo.toml (a

# nothing from this repository — an oracle codec that could reach the subject would stop being
# independent evidence. Same pattern, same stated reason, as `…✳️cad/🔬️probes/📖️reader/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml`
# and `…📐️step/🏅️standards/🔖️ap214/🪆️subsets/✳️cc6/🏭️bridge/Cargo.toml`.
[workspace]

[package]
name = "note-oracle-codec"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
description = "🔮️ Third-party codec for s.note.note@1/✳️any's three registered carriers: the dxf crate WRITES/READS DXF R12 (Ink points.windows(2) -> Line), quick-xml WRITES/READS the SVG XML (per-visible-block <g transform=matrix(...)>), lopdf WRITES/READS the PDF (title + Text block runs, space-joined, one page). Builds fixtures directly, independent of note's own (currently non-building) production serializers."

[[bin]]
name = "note-oracle-codec"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]

quick-xml = "0.42"
lopdf = "0.44"

manifests.source:
[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-s-plugin-imperative-logic"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true

[lints]
workspace = true

[package.metadata.component]
package = "semio:imperative-extension-logic"

[package.metadata.semio]
deployment-directory = "⚖️imperative-extension-logic"
component-kind = "extension"
role = "extension"
extends = "imperative"
contributes = ["imperative.module"]

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.dev]
wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

[features]
# 🔌️ 26/08/17/MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME D3 — mirrors `🌀️procedural`'s `plugin-entry`
# pattern. Default-on so this extension exports its own `extension_exports!` bundle when built as its
# own component; OFF when this file's `🦀️.rs` is `#[path]`-mounted inline into the
# `imperative` plugin's own crate (`imperative`'s `Cargo.toml` declares no such feature, so the cfg
# check below is simply false there) — five extensions mounted into one crate each defining the same
# `#[no_mangle]` `semio_extension_bundle_installer_link_shim` is a duplicate-symbol link error.
default = ["extension-entry"]
extension-entry = []

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
neural_engine = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧠️neural/⚙️engine/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel-neural-engine" }
imperative_extension_sdk = { path = "../../../../../../../✏️s/🔨️modules/📜️imperative/🧩️extension_sdk/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-s-imperative-extension-sdk" }
semio-framework-plugin = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/📦️packages/🦀️rust", features = ["component-guest"], package = "semio-framework-plugin" }
semio-framework = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework" }
pack = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack" }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
